patches.summary: Adds posts-comments and posts --include-comments using Naver's public cbox endpoint.
patches.reason: The generated CLI only exposed comment counts; v2 needs actual comment author/body/timestamp/like data for engagement-quality audits.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./... pass with GOCACHE=/private/tmp/naver-blog-go-cache; live smoke is blocked by sandbox DNS; shipcheck reaches 5/6 legs, with verify blocked by sandbox loopback-listener restrictions.

patches.summary: Adds plain output, explicit terminal detection, cache TTL expiry, typed blog feed projection, and streamable HTTP MCP transport.
patches.reason: These are narrow quality improvements requested after the baseline scorecard: better shell output, clearer terminal behavior, bounded HTTP cache staleness, safer Naver feed numeric decoding, and remote MCP transport support.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./... pass with GOCACHE=/private/tmp/naver-blog-go-cache; scorecard is 90/100; shipcheck reaches 5/6 legs with verify blocked by sandbox loopback-listener restrictions.

patches.summary: Broadens the CLI from campaign-specific scraping to general Naver Blog metadata, media, feed, and comment coverage.
patches.reason: General-purpose influencer and blog audits need profile reach signals, post media URLs, dropped feed metadata, and media-rich comment content that the generated baseline did not surface.
patches.validated_outcome: go build ./..., go vet ./..., and go test ./... pass with GOCACHE=/private/tmp/naver-blog-go-cache after each scope item; original research.json writeback is blocked by sandbox permissions.

patches.summary: Fixes PostView URL generation and routes posts, bundle, and batch engagement through a shared cbox/reaction/PostView primitive.
patches.reason: Naver no longer inlines comment counts in the old PostView shape; cbox is now the authoritative comment-count source while PostView remains useful for publish dates.
patches.validated_outcome: GOCACHE=/private/tmp/naver-blog-go-build go build ./... and go test ./... pass; live Naver smokes are blocked by sandbox DNS; shipcheck still fails verify because printing-press builds ./cmd, which has no Go files in this tree.
